from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687704/attempts/d0cbcca9117b44429be50328a5ec3220/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Expand the top-row marker into diagonal fronts and a periodic inner fill."""
    width = len(grid[0])
    marker = next(c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 2)
    out = [[0 for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(width)]
    for r in range(width):
        for c in range(width):
            if abs(c - marker) == r:
                out[r][c] = 2
            elif abs(c - marker) < r and (c - r - marker) % 4 == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
path=base/'task-cc9a9897.py'
path.write_text(code)
